```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(fuzzyjoin)
library(scales)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

```

```{r load, echo = F}
# Load combined XRF and CNS dataset
combined_df <- read.csv('data/generated/combined/combined_AC_500_inc_coh.csv')

# Load raw CNS data and convert depth to mm
raw.cns <- read_excel('data/POS-22-20_CNS.xlsx') %>%
  mutate(Depth = Depth * 10) %>% # cm to mm
  rename(position..mm. = Depth) %>%
  rename_with(~ gsub('[%/\" ]', '', .x), .cols = matches('TN|TC|TS'))

# Select relevant columns
om.df <- combined_df %>% select(position..mm., TCWt, TSWt, Cr.inc_Cr.coh)

# Correlation for interpolated data
cor_pearson_interp <- cor(om.df$TCWt, om.df$Cr.inc_Cr.coh, use = "complete.obs")
cor_spearman_interp <- cor(om.df$TCWt, om.df$Cr.inc_Cr.coh, method = 'spearman', use = "complete.obs")

# Prepare carbon and inc/coh separately
carbon <- raw.cns %>% select(position..mm., TCWt)
inc.coh <- combined_df %>% select(position..mm., Cr.inc_Cr.coh)

# Fuzzy match by depth
inc.coh_matched <- difference_join(
  carbon, inc.coh,
  by = "position..mm.",
  max_dist = 0.25,
  distance_col = NULL
) %>%
  rename(position..mm. = position..mm..x)



# Correlation for fuzzy-matched data
cor_pearson_raw <- cor(inc.coh_matched$TCWt, inc.coh_matched$Cr.inc_Cr.coh, use = "complete.obs")
cor_spearman_raw <- cor(inc.coh_matched$TCWt, inc.coh_matched$Cr.inc_Cr.coh, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
```

## Correlation Results
### Interpolated Data to XRF Resolution (500µm)
```{r output corr XRF, echo = T}
# Output correlations

cat("- Pearson correlation (TC vs Cr.inc/Cr.coh):", round(cor_pearson_interp, 3), "\n")
cat("- Spearman correlation (TC vs Cr.inc/Cr.coh):", round(cor_spearman_interp, 3), "\n\n")
```
### Interpolated Data to CNS Resolution (2cm)
```{r output corr CNS, echo =T}
cat("### Raw CNS Data (Fuzzy Matched)\n")
cat("- Pearson correlation (TC vs Cr.inc/Cr.coh):", round(cor_pearson_raw, 3), "\n")
cat("- Spearman correlation (TC vs Cr.inc/Cr.coh):", round(cor_spearman_raw, 3), "\n")
```


### Sulfur - Interpolated to CNS resolution (2cm)
```{r output corr sulf, echo =F}
sulfur <- combined_df %>% select(position..mm., S_Ti)
cns_sulf_matched <- difference_join(
  carbon, sulfur,
  by = 'position..mm.',
  max_dist = 0.25,
  distance_col = NULL
) %>%
  rename(position..mm. = position..mm..x)

cor_tc_s <- cor(cns_sulf_matched$TCWt, cns_sulf_matched$S_Ti, use = "complete.obs")
cor_s_cr <- cor(cns_sulf_matched$S_Ti, inc.coh_matched$Cr.inc_Cr.coh, use = "complete.obs")

cat("\n### Additional Proxy (S/Ti)\n")
cat("- TC vs S/Ti:", round(cor_tc_s, 3), "\n")
cat("- S/Ti vs Cr.inc/Cr.coh:", round(cor_s_cr, 3), "\n")
```

```{r plotting, echo = F}
# Rescale Cr inc/coh to match carbon scale
range_TCWt <- range(inc.coh_matched$TCWt, na.rm = TRUE)
range_CrRatio <- range(inc.coh_matched$Cr.inc_Cr.coh, na.rm = TRUE)

rescale_Cr <- function(x) {
  scales::rescale(x, to = range_TCWt, from = range_CrRatio)
}
inv_rescale_Cr <- function(x) {
  scales::rescale(x, to = range_CrRatio, from = range_TCWt)
}

inc.coh_matched <- inc.coh_matched %>%
  mutate(inc.coh.rescaled = rescale_Cr(Cr.inc_Cr.coh))

# Convert to long format for plotting
long_data <- pivot_longer(
  inc.coh_matched,
  cols = c(TCWt, inc.coh.rescaled),
  names_to = "Variable",
  values_to = "Value"
)

line_colors <- c(
  TCWt = "black",
  inc.coh.rescaled = "steelblue"
)

cat("\n## Plot: Total Carbon and Cr.inc/Cr.coh\n")
ggplot(long_data, aes(x = position..mm., y = Value, color = Variable)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = line_colors,
    labels = c(
      TCWt = "Total carbon (%)",
      inc.coh.rescaled = "CrInc/CrCoh (rescaled)"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Total Carbon (wt%)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~inv_rescale_Cr(.), name = "CrInc/CrCoh")
  ) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 3,
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y.left = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(size = 7, color = "steelblue"),
    axis.title.y.left = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(size = 8, color = "steelblue"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8)
  )

```

## Regression parameters
```{r regression-manual-cv, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Ensure required data is available
model_df <- inc.coh_matched %>%
  filter(!is.na(TCWt), !is.na(Cr.inc_Cr.coh))

# Fit linear model
model <- lm(TCWt ~ Cr.inc_Cr.coh, data = model_df)
summary_model <- summary(model)

# Output summary
cat("## Linear Regression Summary\n\n")
cat("**Formula:** TCWt ~ Cr.inc_Cr.coh\n")
cat("**Adjusted R²:**", round(summary_model$adj.r.squared, 3), "\n")
cat("**p-value for Cr.inc_Cr.coh:**", signif(coef(summary_model)[2, 4], 3), "\n")
cat("**Intercept:**", round(coef(model)[1], 3), "\n")
cat("**Slope:**", round(coef(model)[2], 3), "\n\n")


# Predict using the model
model_df$predicted <- predict(model, newdata = model_df)

obs_pred_fit <- lm(formula = predicted ~ TCWt, data = model_df)
```

```{r plot predict obs}
# Plot predicted vs observed
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(model_df, aes(x = TCWt, y = predicted)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_abline(slope = 0.0993, intercept = 3.3222, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = 'blue') +
  labs(
    x = "Observed TC (wt%)",
    y = "Predicted TC (wt%)",
    title = "Predicted vs Observed Total Carbon"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r pred vs obs}
# Manual 10-fold cross-validation
set.seed(42)
n <- nrow(model_df)
folds <- sample(rep(1:10, length.out = n))
rmse_vals <- numeric(10)
r2_vals <- numeric(10)

for (i in 1:10) {
  train <- model_df[folds != i, ]
  test <- model_df[folds == i, ]
  
  m <- lm(TCWt ~ Cr.inc_Cr.coh, data = train)
  preds <- predict(m, newdata = test)
  
  # Calculate RMSE
  rmse_vals[i] <- sqrt(mean((test$TCWt - preds)^2))
  
  # Calculate R²
  ss_res <- sum((test$TCWt - preds)^2)
  ss_tot <- sum((test$TCWt - mean(test$TCWt))^2)
  r2_vals[i] <- 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
}

cat("## Manual 10-Fold Cross-Validation Results\n")
cat("Mean RMSE:", round(mean(rmse_vals), 3), "\n")
cat("Mean R²:", round(mean(r2_vals), 3), "\n\n")

# Diagnostic plots
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(model)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
